// CASE swift_inorder_label expect=pass
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async rethrows {
  for item in items {
    try await step(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_mwc expect=pass
func mapWithConcurrency(items: [Int], width: Int, operation: @escaping @Sendable (Int) async throws -> Void) async throws {
  for offset in stride(from: 0, to: items.count, by: width) {
    try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
      for item in items[offset..<min(offset + width, items.count)] {
        group.addTask { try await operation(item) }
      }
      try await group.waitForAll()
    }
  }
}
